q1_issues.issue: (Ongoing sk_sell_1) has no licensed marker — a gerund in a "by V-ing" adjunct is none of the four explicit Ongoing triggers, and the parse emits no Start that would carry the "since" continuative reading it seems to be standing in for.

(Past sk_launch_1) over-emits on a temporal-anchor event noun, which takes its class atom and the ordering relation and nothing else; tense atoms are for finite clauses, and "a week ago" is already carried by (BeforeBy sk_launch_1 now 1 week).

q2_gaps: a "by V-ing" means/method adjunct clause — the preposition-named oblique is defined for a preposition with an object NP, and Instrument is explicitly restricted to a tool, substance or conduit, so a whole eventuality as the means has no stated route (the parse coined (By <event> <event>) by analogy)

"since" anchored on an event noun rather than a time — Start/End slots take structured time terms or constants, while the event-noun anchor rule yields only an ordering, so the start-boundary half of "since the launch" has no carrier and the parse emitted a bare Before
notes: The seal is well partitioned: the definite launch and store typings plus the compound decompositions project, while the Of-argument, the Possession and the Past-inside-the-seal all stay sealed as the interim projection table requires.
